name: Plum-Monix Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Plum-Monix Industry Co Ltd is a Taiwan-based company engaged in petrochemical waste treatment and resource recovery. The company produces and reprocesses rare elements like vanadium and molybdenum from petrochemical waste catalysts. Its main products, including molybdenum trioxide, vanadium pentoxide, ferromolybdenum, and ferrovanadium, serve the iron and steel, green energy, and alloy industries.
